**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Corio:

- **Section 2 grants (p0030, p0033–p0035)** are all "nonexclusive" licences *to* us; nothing restricts us from hosting or reselling other vendors' software.
- **Section 2.4 (p0035–p0036)** runs in our favour (Commerce One may not contact Corio Customers about non-ASP licence sales and must refer inbound Customers to us) — exclusivity benefiting Customer, not flagged.
- **Section 14.8 (p0131)** expressly confirms we solely direct the Corio Services and may subcontract to third parties at any time.
- **Exhibit D (p0198)** is expressly "non-binding," so the cooperation, joint-marketing and initial-customer items create no de facto exclusivity; the Exhibit B revenue-share is a payment mechanic, not a requirements commitment.
- Sections 13 (Shared Resources) and 14 contain no non-compete, field-of-use or requirements covenant.

No redline proposed.
